package.name: aav_legacy_rs
package.description: legacy_uart_bridge in Rust (rclrs): the default since 17 Nov (Ben: "Rust tomorrow"), beside aav_legacy's Python one (legacy.launch.py legacy_impl:=rust|python). The same node name, topics, QoS, parameters and frames: ego's commands (/control/car/actuator_cmd), the Orin's counter and /safety/estop become the ESP32's UART frames (versions 1, 2, 3, packed by the firmware's own legacy-link), and its uplink frames become /vehicle/status, /vehicle/rc and the rest. The logic is the legacy-bridge crate, with no ROS, checked against the Python modules' answers.
